_notes: Oba-Oba on standard Taito do Brasil hardware. Shares the data layout of taito.map.json, but uses the early display layout: the current player is shown on the credits digit (0x408D) and the credits on the match/player digit (0x408F).
Layout verified by instrumenting PinMAME (headless libpinmame) with deterministic games on obaoba.
2026-07: Initial map compiled by Andre Santana.

_notes: `scores` is display memory: during a game it shows the live scores, in attract mode it cycles between the last game's scores, a factory number and blank (0xFF) digits.
`final_scores` holds the scores of the last completed game; 0xFF bytes mean the player did not take part.

current_ball._notes: 0 in attract mode, 1-5 while a game is in progress (including the match/game over sequence)
current_ball.label: Ball in Play

game_over._notes: GAME OVER lamp (bit 0 of the last byte of the lamp DMA RAM): lit in attract mode, off while a game is in progress
game_over.label: Game Over

01._notes: keeps counting when credits are spent
01.label: Coin Counter
